WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cust_id,
        SUM(s.quantity_sold * (c.unit_price - c.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM sales s
    JOIN costs c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE t.calendar_year = 2021 
    AND t.calendar_month_desc = '2021-12'
    AND cu.country_id = 52770
    GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_id,
        total_profit,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) as bucket
    FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT 
    bucket,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    MIN(total_profit) as min_profit,
    MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
